GTFO — sound

Generated by tools/sfx_gen.py. There is no screenshot for sound, so this is how you check it: click a waveform to hear it. Looping sounds latch, so you can stack a land's bed with what lives in it (try amb_red + amb_wreck + amb_suit) and hear what the astronaut hears. The sliders are the mix the game actually uses — the gain_db from audio.json plus its bus — so if something is too loud here it is too loud in the game, and the fix is a number in RECIPES, not a line of GDScript.
